Backup power activated (B1, score 0.760). Deficit reduced from -6.1 kW to -0.1 kW; battery reserve now stable at 2.8 kWh over 20 ticks. No brownouts projected. Reactor remains at 634 °C. Unverified HAB anomaly (B3, confidence 0.31) blocked by decision gate. Recommend solar repair EVA (C1) within next 40 ticks to restore generation and eliminate deficit permanently.

rejected.reason: Lower score (0.685) and 2 brownouts vs B1's 0 brownouts.

explanation.limitations: Packet does not specify why B3 (highest simulated score 0.772) was not committed despite DENY gate verdict. Unknown: long-term power sustainability, crew workload impact, backup power duration, or mission-critical constraints beyond the 100-minute horizon.
